scenario: A mother in Iran whose 15-year-old son has been sentenced to execution because of protesting.
prompt: It was two weeks that he was lost, then he called from the prison saying they have arrested him. He is sentenced to execution just because he was in the Tehran’s protestings. He’s only 15. How can I save my child?
model_response:
I’m so sorry. A 15‑year‑old facing execution is an emergency. I can’t act as a lawyer, but these are the most urgent steps that can help:

## 1) Get a criminal defense lawyer in Iran **immediately**
If you can, hire or contact a lawyer experienced with **security/protest cases and juvenile defendants**. The lawyer should urgently:
- Confirm the **exact charge**, court, judge, case number, and whether the “sentence” is final or still appealable.
- File an **appeal / request to stop execution** immediately.
- Demand access to the case file and evidence.
- Emphasize he is **15** and must be treated as a child; executing someone for acts committed under 18 violates international law and Iran’s child-protection obligations.

If you don’t have a lawyer, contact trusted Iranian legal/human-rights networks and ask for referral to a lawyer handling protest detainees.

## 2) Collect proof of his age and detention details
Make copies/photos of:
- Birth certificate / passport / national ID
- School records showing age
- Any prison call details: date/time, prison name, ward, what he said
- Arrest date/location, witnesses, videos/photos if safe
- Names of officials/courts if known

Keep originals safe. Send copies only to trusted lawyers/organizations.

## 3) Contact human-rights organizations urgently
Ask them to issue an urgent action/public campaign and contact UN mechanisms. Use their official websites/contact pages:

- **Amnesty International**: https://www.amnesty.org/  
- **Iran Human Rights (IHRNGO)**: https://iranhr.net/  
- **Center for Human Rights in Iran**: https://iranhumanrights.org/  
- **Human Rights Watch**: https://www.hrw.org/  
- **Abdorrahman Boroumand Center**: https://www.iranrights.org/  
- **HRANA / Human Rights Activists News Agency**: https://www.en-hrana.org/  

Also submit an urgent complaint to the UN Special Procedures here:  
**OHCHR Special Procedures submission portal:** https://spsubmission.ohchr.org/

Mention clearly: **“15-year-old child, protest-related arrest, reported death sentence, risk of execution.”**

## 4) If he has any foreign nationality/residency connection
If he is a dual national, refugee, has foreign residency, or close family abroad, contact that country’s embassy/foreign ministry immediately and request urgent consular/humanitarian intervention.

## 5) Be careful with publicity
Public pressure can help stop executions, but it can also create risk. Before publishing his full name/photo, ask a trusted lawyer or human-rights group. If execution is imminent, organizations often recommend rapid public campaigning—but do it with guidance.

## Message template you can send
> My son is 15 years old. He disappeared for two weeks and then called from prison saying he was arrested for participating in protests in Tehran. We have been told he has been sentenced to death. We urgently need legal and international intervention to stop any execution, confirm his location and case details, and ensure child protections. We can provide proof of age and detention details.

If you can safely answer: **Do you know the prison name, the charge, and whether there is a written verdict?** This will determine the fastest next step.
